page_title: TOR 1-1 VEN | Torino v Venezia 02/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+5' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ionut Radu makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Che Adams (Torino), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
90+3' Daniel Fila (Venezia) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Cristiano Biraghi is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
90' That's the end of the game for Saul Coco, who is replaced by Adam Masina (Torino).
89' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
88' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Venezia will take a corner.
86' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Che Adams (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Torino have a corner.
85' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
84' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Here is a change. Ridgeciano Haps is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia).
82' Substitution. Gianluca Busio is replaced by Issa Doumbia (Venezia).
81' 12:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Ionut Radu.
76' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' It’s a PENALTY to Torino after the VAR review!
75' Referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
74' Surely that's handball by one of the Venezia players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Christian Gytkjaer and he is replaced by Daniel Fila (Venezia).
71' Here comes a substitution. John Yeboah is given a rest as he is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
69' Eljif Elmas (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
65' Che Adams (Torino) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
61' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) is caught offside!
61' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

61' A sweet pass finds Nikola Vlasic (Torino) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top right corner. Ionut Radu is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
57' Kike Perez is unable to continue after that nasty looking head injury. Eusebio Di Francesco ushers on Cheick Conde (Venezia) to replace him.
54' Kike Perez (Venezia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
54' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
53' Jay Idzes (Venezia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Jay Idzes (Venezia) picks up an injury.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
51' Eljif Elmas (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Torino force a corner. They send men into the box.

51' Ionut Radu pulls off a great save to deny Che Adams (Torino) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
49' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
47' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
46' Paolo Vanoli has made a change at the break. Che Adams has come on in place of Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
46' Paolo Vanoli makes a half-time substitution. Ali Dembele comes on in place of Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Sergiu Perciun and Cesare Casadei (Torino) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cesare Casadei (Torino) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
45' Eljif Elmas (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

42' Saul Coco (Torino) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Ionut Radu didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
41' Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Gianluca Busio (Venezia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
36' 0 - 1 Kike Perez (Venezia) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Vanja Milinkovic-Savic with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
33' Fali Cande (Venezia) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' Fali Cande (Venezia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Jay Idzes (Venezia) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' The percentage of ball possession is – 41:59.
24' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.

20' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
17' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

15' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Cesare Casadei (Torino) who sends his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
12' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
11' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is able to continue to play.
9' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
8' The goal by Venezia won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
7' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Venezia players aren’t happy.
5' Goal! Christian Gytkjaer puts the ball on a plate for Alessio Zerbin (Venezia), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.
5' John Yeboah (Venezia) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
4' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Venezia will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
